activeRecallQuiz.scenario: If +DI is above -DI, but the ADX line is below 18 and pointing downward, should you initiate a trend-following breakout trade?
activeRecallQuiz.question: If +DI is above -DI, but the ADX line is below 18 and pointing downward, should you initiate a trend-following breakout trade?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: No. While +DI > -DI shows a slight bullish tilt, ADX below 18 proves a non-trending sideways market where trend-following models suffer whipsaws.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
Separate gross theoretical payoff from real-world net profit.
Follow disciplined risk and position sizing limits on every trade.
